title: Chris Bledsoe's Lady and the Guardians
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Chris Bledsoe's Lady and the Guardians, about 2007 onward at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Bledsoe believes that the non-human intelligence he is in contact with, which he has termed the Lady, is linked to the Dipper and that her companions call themselves {quote} the Guardians.
He reports numerous encounters that don't resemble crafts, lights, or UFOs at all, but what he [music] describes as a luminous feminine presence
tellings.difference: Calls her a luminous feminine presence unlike crafts or lights, and does not mention the Dipper or the Guardians.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe Bledsoe's ongoing contact with the non-human feminine presence he calls the Lady, starting in 2007.

as_told.title: Encounters with a luminous feminine presence (the Lady)

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of Chris Bledsoe, an American man who says he has been in contact with a non-human intelligence since around 2007. Michels says Bledsoe calls this being the Lady, links her to the Big Dipper star pattern, and says her companions call themselves the Guardians; in another telling Michels leaves those details out and describes her as a glowing feminine presence, not a craft or a light. If true, it would mean contact with something that does not look like the usual idea of a UFO at all.
